sources.title: Liziba Station: A Through-building Light Rail Station
sources.content:
Liziba Station represents an architectural marvel in Chongqing's urban landscape. Located at 39 Liziba Zhengjie Street in Yuzhong District, this facility on Rail Transit Line 2 gained fame as the first straddle-type monorail elevated station in China to be co-constructed and co-exist with residential and commercial buildings.

Key Facts:
Completion: March 2004
Opening Date: June 18, 2005 (trial operations)
Hours: 6:30 AM - 11:30 PM
Train Interval: Approximately 7 minutes
Admission: Free
Visit Duration: About 30 minutes

Unique Design Features: The rail transit station bridge and the residential and commercial buildings are set up separately. Train tracks occupy the 6th and 7th floors of a 19-story building, while the platform sits on the 8th floor. This separation prevents vibration and noise transmission to residents above.

Why It Was Built This Way: Chongqing's mountainous terrain and dense residential zones made traditional construction impossible. Rather than relocating thousands of residents, engineers innovatively routed the monorail through the building itself.

Things to Do: Marvel at the monorail passing through the building from observation platforms. Browse the cultural and creative zone featuring merchandise and DIY assembly blocks. Explore the Bayu Old News Exhibition Hall documenting Chongqing's history. Sample authentic cuisine at nearby Liziba Old Street.

Best Photography Locations:
1. Observation Platform: 1,376 square meters across from the station, accommodating approximately 5,000 people simultaneously
2. Exit 2: Walking 200 meters down the road provides excellent photo angles
3. Beibin Road: Offers comprehensive views

Visitor Tips: Arrive during weekday mornings or evenings to avoid crowds. Stand on the right side of escalators; walk on the left (local custom). Keep noise minimal - local residents live above the station.

Nearby Attractions: Three Gorges Museum (3 km away), E'ling Park, Liziba Anti-Japanese War Relics Park, Ciqikou Ancient Town.

Accessibility: From downtown attractions like Liberation Monument and Hongya Cave, the journey takes approximately 25 minutes via Line 2.

sources.title: Liziba: Where Chongqing's Trains Disappear in a Building
sources.content:
Liziba is notable as China's first light rail overhead station built directly through a residential apartment building on Chongqing Rail Transit 2 (CRT 2). The station represents a distinctive engineering solution where the monorail passes through the structure of a multi-story building rather than around it. This design allows trains to travel through the middle of the residential complex.

The site has become a popular photography destination, attracting visitors interested in documenting this unusual architectural feat. The contrast between urban transit infrastructure and residential living space creates visually compelling images.

This station exemplifies innovative urban planning in Chongqing, demonstrating how modern transit systems adapt to existing urban landscapes while maintaining residential functionality. It has become an emblematic symbol of the city's development and engineering ingenuity.

sources.title: Discover Liziba Station: A Beginner's Guide for Travelers
sources.content:
Liziba Station is one of the world's most unique metro stations. Opened in 2005, instead of demolishing a 19-story building to make way for the rail line, city planners took a bold step: they routed the monorail through the building with the station platform located between the 6th and 8th floors.

Best Experience: Take Line 2 to the station, get off, and head to the viewing platform to watch the trains pass through the building. Trains pass through every few minutes.

Best Time to Visit: Go between 9:00 AM - 11:00 AM or late afternoon for the best lighting. Mid-day sun can be harsh for photos.

Practical Tips: The viewing area has no shade, so bring sunscreen and a hat. You do not need a separate ticket to visit the viewing area. However, you will need a metro ticket to ride Line 2. This place gets more than 5 million visitors each year.

sources.title: Liziba station - Wikipedia
sources.content: Liziba is a monorail station on Line 2 of Chongqing Rail Transit located in Yuzhong District and opened in 2005. The station is unique in that it is located on the sixth to eighth floors of a 19-story residential building, with the monorail trains going through the middle of the building. The station has 2 exits.

sources.title: Liziba Station (2026) - Chongqing - Tripadvisor
sources.content: Liziba Station visitor reviews from Tripadvisor. A unique attraction where the monorail literally goes through an apartment building. Great for photography. The viewing platform below offers the best vantage point. Free to visit. Worth a quick stop if you're in Chongqing. Signs are usually clear, and it's a direct stop on Line 2 of the Chongqing Metro.

sources.title: 李子坝站 - 维基百科
sources.content:
李子坝站位于重庆市渝中区，是重庆轨道交通2号线车站，车站编号2/07。李子坝站为高架车站，位于一幢19层建筑物的六楼至八楼，以下楼层是商铺，以上则是住宅。车站共设有2个出入口。

重庆轨道交通2号线李子坝车站是国内第一座与商住楼共建共存的跨座式单轨高架车站，于2004年3月建成，占地面积3100平方米，建筑面积6000平方米。该站位于嘉陵江畔的李子坝正街39号商住楼6-7层。

当地相关部门在轻轨站下方修建了一个1200多平方米的观景平台，设有旅游大巴落客区、拍摄广场平台区、玻璃栈桥观景区以及步行通道，能同时容纳约5000人参观游览。

sources.title: 重庆李子坝轻轨站游玩攻略 - 携程攻略
sources.content: 重庆李子坝轻轨站游玩攻略。因"轨道穿楼而过"成为蜚声中外的打卡车站。观景平台设有旅游大巴落客区、拍摄广场平台区、玻璃栈桥观景区以及步行通道，能同时容纳约5000人参观游览。免费参观，建议游玩时间30分钟-1小时。
